scientific_question: Where is the representative-level one-contour to two-contour transition within the already established N=384 bracket 3.2<delta<4.4?
evidence_role: topology-only locator; fixed-sigma action transfer is intentionally not evaluated
classification_rule: connected if primary representative contour count == 1; disconnected if count >= 2
perimeter_primary_rule: a contour is primary when its perimeter is at least 10% of the largest contour perimeter at that level
source_family: equal-injection two-center max-union of compact polynomial disk profiles
source_profile_definition: S=A*max((1-r1^2/R^2)_+^2,(1-r2^2/R^2)_+^2), with d/R=delta and R chosen pre-run so integral(S/A)=pi/3
forbidden_during_stage: selection of bisection branch using any quantity other than topology classification
stop_rule: Run exactly four adaptive bisection trajectories unless a numerical validity failure occurs. Do not add points after seeing results.
next_stage_rule: Only after B26.1 is closed may a new, non-overlapping held-out B26.2 fixed-sigma transfer protocol be frozen from the refined topology bracket.
